notes: What createHandRanking(codes) reads from the card-deck component: its CardCodes value (card-deck's `cardCodes`). With no argument the standard fifty-two card codes built into poker-hand-ranking are used. Card codes are two characters, rank then suit.

cardCodes.returns: CardCodes (a value; rankOf and suitOf give 0 for a two and the suit's place in `suits`, rankNames and rankPlurals are for the hand names, fullDeck lists the fifty-two cards)
